tasks.title: Enforce SVG color, typography, accessibility, and optical-size policy
tasks.risk: Hard-coded colors, embedded text, incomplete descriptions, and untested optical weight create theme, localization, accessibility, and rendering drift.
acceptance_criteria: Asset-kind-specific rules define when fixed colors and embedded text are permitted.
Informative assets have required accessible metadata while decorative assets are explicitly classified.
Primitive icons pass optical-size review at 16, 20, 24, and 32 pixels in light and dark themes.
Font-dependent artwork has a documented rendering and licensing contract.

tasks.title: Complete native Penpot library and freeze typography and density contracts
tasks.risk: The current Penpot package is a bootstrap reference, leaving component variants and visual decisions distributed across JSON, SVG, CSS, and React.
acceptance_criteria: A native Penpot library defines critical primitives and components with variants, states, and responsive behavior.
Display, body, and mono typography are frozen with licensing, loading, and fallback decisions.
Editorial, comfortable, and compact density modes are tokenized and documented.
Generated reference boards remain separate from editable design-system components.

tasks.title: Add semantic motion contracts and improve visual asset discovery
tasks.risk: Motion files and dark or transparent vectors can be present and indexed while remaining ambiguous, inaccessible, or hard to inspect.
acceptance_criteria: Every motion asset declares meaning, duration, loop policy, reduced-motion fallback, criticality, and file-size budget.
Explorer previews use an adaptive neutral/checkerboard surface for dark and transparent vectors.
Loading, failure, and fallback preview states are visible and keyboard-accessible.
Compact discovery mode preserves searchable metadata without the full specimen density.
